entity.elemental.chronicle_guide.name: Aeron, the Last Skywright
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.desc: Forged with salvaged Skyforge avionics and buoyant aerogel.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.thrust: ► Hold [Space] airborne to thrust at Elytra speed in your look direction.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.glide: ► Hold [Sneak] while falling to glide safely.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.guidance: ► Press [G] to toggle Waypoint Guidance HUD.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_intro: Why does this world look so corrupted... and who are you?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_intro: I am Aeron, the Last Skywright. What you see is the scarring of a cosmic tremor that shattered the Crucible of Creation.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_guard: The Crucible of Creation? What happened to the ancient guardians?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_guardi: Six primal currents once flowed in harmony. But when the Primordial Core fractured, darkness took root. Sir Solvane fell, cursed into the Everliving Knight. Terrakon stirs as the Seismic Colossus.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_balan: Is there any way to restore balance? What can I do?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_balanc: You bear the spark of the Last Element-Smith. Take supplies from my camp chest. But first, you must take to the skies. Long ago, our caravel crashed nearby.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_ship: A crashed ship? Where is it buried?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_ship: Buried between the stone and dirt layers nearby. Salvage 4 Pneumatic Pistons, 2 Aerogel Cores, and the Jetpack Blueprint from its hold!
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_ready: Understood. I will unearth the wreckage and assemble the jetpack at a Crafting Table.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_go: I have calibrated your compass to its coordinates. Go, unearth the Skyforge Wreckage!
dialogue.elemental.player.reminder: Aeron, remind me of what I need to salvage.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.reminder_recipe: Unearth the buried crashed ship: salvage 4 Pneumatic Pistons, 2 Aerogel Cores, and the Jetpack Blueprint. Assemble them with an Element Core at a Crafting Table!
dialogue.elemental.player.complete: Aeron, I've assembled the Elemental Jetpack!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.return_1: Magnificent craftsmanship! The Skyforge Jetpack is whole once more. Its thrusters will carry you to the highest peaks.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.multiplayer_bon: I see you do not walk this broken path alone. Take these surplus jetpacks so your companions may take flight as well!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.scimitar_lore_1: Now, your true trial begins. The Sunforged Scimitar was the weapon of Sir Solvane before the corruption claimed him.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.scimitar_lore_2: Its blazing edge was quenched in arid sands. Journey to the Desert to forge the Dry Heat Element and unearth its secrets.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.desert_waypoint: I have calibrated your waypoint toward the nearest Desert expanse. May the sun guide your blade, Element-Smith!
dialogue.elemental.player.desert_ready: I'm heading to the Desert. Thank you, Aeron.
